renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Tame your thinking and being gets done. Be perfect, be free. As here, so everywhere. Watch the seed. Sit and sink happy in the lake. Make your own measure. When wisdom dies, birth dies. Mother-sounds rule the bound.

In three pour the fourth like oil. Dive in with your own mind. Watch even while breathing. Birth low things in the middle. What was destroyed rises again when mothers join without sure knowing. Become god-equal. Your body-life is the vow. All talk is chanting. All gifts are self-knowing.

paragraphs.text: Wit tamed, being done. Perfect = free. As here so there. Seed watched. Sit sunk happy in the lake. Own measure made. Wisdom dies, birth dies. Mother-sounds own the bound.
